title: Mike Vrabel discusses ‘difficult conversations’ following Dianna Russini photos

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Mike Vrabel discusses ‘difficult conversations’ following Dianna Russini photos
sources.description: New England Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel addressed the media for the first time on Tuesday since photos circulated of Vrabel holding hands and spending time at an adults-only resort with Dianna Russini, former NFL reporter for The Athletic.
